items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Bucket got a hole in there, it was just famous. Maple Leaf Rag, he used to play tough stuff, you know.

ctx.x: Do you remember any numbers he used to play? Do you remember any numbers that he used to play, any tunes?

Well, a couple of something like that. Bucket got a hole in there, it was just famous. Maple Leaf Rag, he used to play tough stuff, you know. Palermo Rag, Hard Society, he played all that. Now, I tell you what he did on Hard Society. He never played the lead this part. He never played that. He played the lead. He played the lead.
He played all the time. Let the clang out or something else take the lead.
